attr.title: Trasmoz Legends Arcade Edition
attr.desc: Step into the final chapter of the Trasmoz saga, a story that began with critically acclaimed homebrew hits on ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC. Now, in this arcade-style adventure, you will experience the definitive version of the Trasmoz series as it would have been imagined in the golden age of arcades. Trasmoz Legends Arcade Edition is a special edition of the game intended for arcade cabinets and CRT screens.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Itch.io, download the Trasmoz Legends Raspberry Pi 64bits package and copy trasmoz.port into port folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Itch.io](https://volcanobytes.itch.io/trasmoz-legends), download the `Trasmoz Legends Raspberry Pi 64bits` package and copy `trasmoz.port` into port folder.
